candidates.location_hint: the skip-to-content link at the very top of the layout
candidates.why: It uses a negative vertical offset to hide itself, which may not fully remove it from the visual viewport or screen reader focus order on all devices; worth verifying it is truly inaccessible until focused.

candidates.location_hint: the focus ring applied to the navigation links
candidates.why: The negative outline offset combined with the dark navigation background might cause the focus indicator to clip, bleed into adjacent items, or lack sufficient contrast against the bar.

candidates.location_hint: the copyright text inside the page footer
candidates.why: The gray text color on the light gray footer background could potentially fall short of minimum contrast ratios for body text.

candidates.location_hint: the main content container targeted by the skip link
candidates.why: Keyboard users may not see the focus move to this area after activating the skip link, depending on how the browser handles focus for this type of container; worth confirming the target receives and shows focus.

candidates.location_hint: the horizontal list of navigation links
candidates.why: Applying flex layout directly to a link list can occasionally interfere with how assistive technologies announce list semantics or manage keyboard traversal; worth confirming proper announcement order.
